item.text:
Implemented `storage.readOnly` as an optional backend setting. Configuration now rejects any explicit value on non-database storage with the required error. The UI uses that setting for read-only state, defaults to read-only for non-database backends when it is absent, and shows a Read-Only badge with the active backend’s icon. Authentication bootstrap also skips the database when authentication is disabled on non-database storage.

Added the requested [invalid configuration fixture](/app/internal/config/testdata/storage/invalid_readonly.yml) and regression tests. `go test ./internal/config ./internal/cmd` and `git diff --check` passed. The UI build and tests remain unverified because `npm` and installed UI dependencies are absent; details are in the [checkpoint](/app/.codex-role-output/checkpoint.md).
